offers: Enterprise migration: up to $10K in credits
Application and architecture review for production business workloads. Individual amount varies; issuance follows completed migration and team review. No reusable public code was verified.

terms: Personal/non-production projects, test workloads, incomplete information and unverifiable spend estimates may not qualify. The FAQ directs pre-seed and seed-stage startups to the startup program.
The solutions team reviews the application and schedules an architecture review. Credits are not issued automatically when the form is sent.
The startup page states that all credits are valid for 1 year from approval. This statement is not assigned to enterprise migration credits.
The directory lists offers from partner software providers. These are not presented here as discounts on Render hosting.
No fixed enterprise campaign closing date or guaranteed individual award is quoted. An unpublished closing date does not mean permanent. This page does not quote hosting prices.
